import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_40/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_40/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on "school_name"
# Both tables have "school_name" column, join on it
joined_df = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Operation 2: group_by Source2_40_0.school_name, aggregation avg(Source2_40_0.reading_score)
# Group by the school_name from Source2_40_0 (which is the same as joined_df.school_name)
# Aggregate average reading_score from Source2_40_0 (which is df0.reading_score, now joined_df.reading_score)
grouped_df = joined_df.groupby("school_name", as_index=False)["reading_score"].mean()

# Rename columns to match target schema exactly
# Target schema: ['school_name': string, 'reading_score': float]
grouped_df = grouped_df.rename(columns={"reading_score": "reading_score"})

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_40/target_multisource.csv"
grouped_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_40/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_40/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on school_name (inner join to keep only matching schools)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Group by school_name and aggregate average reading_score
result = joined.groupby("school_name", as_index=False).agg({"reading_score": "mean"})

# Ensure column order and names exactly as target schema
result = result[["school_name", "reading_score"]]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_40/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
